BrochureContent.Content:
A superb four-bedroom detached residence presented in excellent condition and standing on a fantastic mature site at Kilmainham, Kells, Co. Meath.

Peacefully situated along a quiet residential lane just off the old N3 Navan / Kells Road, the property offers spacious family accommodation in a private countryside setting, only minutes from Kells and close to Headfort Golf Club.

The residence has been carefully maintained and upgraded over the years.

Outside, an impressive gated entrance with stone boundary walls opens onto a sweeping tarmac driveway, extensive lawns, generous parking and a detached garage.

This is an excellent family home in a sought-after and highly convenient location, with easy access to the many amenities of Kells and the nearby M3 Motorway.
